Cellular phylogenies provide developmental context, but incorporating relationships among individual cells into gene-level regulatory inference remains challenging. RESULTS: We present scPhyloGRN, a supervised framework that integrates single-cell gene expression with cellular phylogeny to prioritize directed transcription factor (TF)-target candidates within the observed gene set. The framework maps cell ancestry to gene associations that guide graph construction, attention in a dual-stream encoder, and lineage-consistency regularization. We evaluated scPhyloGRN against ten methods across 17 dataset-reference settings spanning four mouse embryos and one Caenorhabditis elegans dataset. scPhyloGRN showed an overall advantage in regulatory edge prioritization, supported by additional evaluations using shared candidate spaces. Removing lineage information reduced AUPRC in the ablation analyses, while branch-level and regulator-level analyses showed improved ranking and recovery of reference-supported regulatory candidates. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Source code and analysis workflows are available at https://github.com/Maria0852/scPhyloGRN, with a versioned archive at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22793831.

summary.takeaway: 提出 scPhyloGRN，将单细胞基因表达与细胞谱系拓扑结合，用于在观测基因集内优先排序有向的转录因子-靶基因候选边。
summary.methods: 监督式框架：把细胞祖先关系映射为基因关联，用于指导图构建、双流编码器中的注意力以及谱系一致性正则化；在涵盖四个小鼠胚胎和一个线虫数据集的 17 个数据集-参考设置上与十种方法比较。
summary.relevance: 直接面向 GRN/Regulon 推断，利用发育谱系信息改进调控边优先级。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅笼统报告总体优势与消融结果，未给出具体性能数值；比较依赖所采用的参考网络与数据集设置。

papers.title: Gene Regulatory Networks that Support Multi-fate Cellular Decisions.
papers.abstract: Cell fate decisions are driven by gene regulatory networks (GRNs). While the mutually inhibitory toggle switch effectively models binary fate decisions, fully connected inhibitory networks with more than two nodes fail to capture multi-fate decisions due to the low prevalence of "single high states", where only a single master regulator is highly expressed. The goal of this study is to find network structures that support all single high states. We find that the only network that attains the highest possible prevalence of all single high states within the set of monotone Boolean (MB) models is completely disconnected. Since biological networks typically require connectivity, we investigate network structures that support equipotency, where all single high states have equal prevalence within MB models. Finally, we characterize the networks that support multistability between all single high states, finding that it is possible only in networks in which each node either has self-activations or is inhibited by every other network node. Our findings provide a theoretical framework for understanding the network design principles that can support simultaneous differentiation into multiple distinct cell types.

summary.takeaway: 在单调布尔网络模型中分析支持多命运细胞决策的网络结构，发现同时支持所有单高态的网络需具备特定连接条件。
summary.methods: 理论分析单调布尔模型；考察单高态普遍性、等势性以及所有单高态之间的多稳态，并刻画满足条件的网络结构。
summary.relevance: 为 GRN 网络设计原则与多细胞命运分化提供理论框架，属于 GRN/Regulon 主题。
summary.caveat: 基于单调布尔模型的抽象理论分析，摘要未说明其结论在真实生物网络中的验证程度。

papers.title: Bridging Structure and Semantics: Knowledge Graph Verification via Triple-to-Text Alignment
papers.abstract: Semantic accuracy is an important dimension of knowledge graph quality. Graph-based scoring methods exploit relational structure, while textual representations allow classifiers to draw on knowledge encoded by pre-trained language models (PLMs). We present GenVer, a generative verifier that scores triples using both their serialized form and generated natural language representations (NLRs). A triple-text alignment procedure selects training pairs for a sequence-to-sequence generator; a BERT-based classifier then combines features from each triple and its generated NLR. On four FactFB variants, constructed from FB15k using perturbed negative triples, GenVer obtains the highest classification accuracy among the evaluated baselines, ranging from 88.56% to 91.52%. The experiments suggest that generated representations can help triple classification, while the case analysis also exposes semantic drift and high-confidence errors.

summary.takeaway: 提出生成式验证器 GenVer，利用生成的自然语言表示与三元组序列化形式共同进行知识图谱三元组分类。
summary.methods: 通过三元组-文本对齐选择训练对，训练序列到序列生成器产生自然语言表示，再用 BERT 分类器融合三元组及其生成文本特征；在基于 FB15k 构造的四个 FactFB 变体上评估。
summary.relevance: 属于知识图谱质量验证与语义对齐，与知识图谱主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告分类准确率为 88.56%–91.52%，但案例分析暴露语义漂移和高置信度错误；负样本来自扰动构造。

papers.title: Selective Retrieval Routing for Multi-Violation Knowledge Graph Repair
papers.abstract: Knowledge graphs often contain missing or inconsistent facts that undermine the applications built on them. Schema validation detects such violations but does not identify which of several valid repairs recovers the intended graph. External corpora can supply the evidence needed to identify the intended repair, but retrieving from them is costly and not always successful. We propose a framework for selective retrieval in iterative graph repair. An LLM repair agent explores and edits the graph, while a router controls its access to a researcher agent that retrieves external evidence. We extend a violation-injection framework to generate cases with multiple compatible violations and known reference repairs. The agent's repair outcomes on these cases provide supervision for training the deployment-specific router. On two building-automation datasets, researcher access improves repairs for some violations and degrades them for others, with effects differing across deployments. The router uses fewer repair-time tokens than always enabling access in all six evaluation suites. It achieves higher repair $F_1$ than always disabling access in five of six suites.

summary.takeaway: 提出选择性检索框架，用路由器控制 LLM 修复代理何时调用检索外部证据的研究代理，以进行多违规知识图谱修复。
summary.methods: 扩展违规注入框架生成含多个兼容违规且带参考修复的案例；以修复结果为监督训练部署特定路由器；在两个建筑自动化数据集、六个评估套件上评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及知识图谱修复、外部证据检索与 LLM 代理，与知识图谱及检索增强相关。
summary.caveat: 检索访问对不同违规和不同部署效果不一致；摘要未给出具体 F1 数值，跨领域泛化未充分说明。

papers.title: RELAY: Relational In-Context Learning for Cellular Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract: Cellular responses to perturbations vary across multiple experimental variables, such as perturbation identity, cell type, donor, and dose, defining a multidimensional condition space in which each measured population occupies one coordinate. Existing methods predict unmeasured conditions using explicit representations of these variable values, generalizing unseen values therefore depends on the availability and quality of such representations. We present RELAY, a relational in-context model that predicts unmeasured coordinates from measured responses at related coordinates. For each target, RELAY uses measured control--perturbed pairs from conditions that share one or more experimental variables with the target, such as the same perturbation in another cell type. The model receives only which variables are shared, not their values, and uses these demonstrations to predict the target response. We evaluate RELAY on chemical, genetic, and cytokine perturbation datasets under two settings: unseen combinations, where test values are individually observed during training but not in their target combinations, and unseen variable values, where test values are introduced only through context at inference. RELAY outperforms existing in-context methods on unseen variable values and supervised perturbation-prediction methods on unseen combinations. All resources will be open sourced, including code and data.

summary.takeaway: 提出 RELAY，一种关系式上下文学习模型，利用与目标共享部分实验变量的已测扰动响应来预测未测条件下的细胞扰动响应。
summary.methods: 对每个目标，选取与目标共享一个或多个实验变量（如相同扰动的其他细胞类型）的对照-扰动配对作为示范；模型仅接收共享哪些变量而非变量值；在化学、遗传和细胞因子扰动数据集上评估未见组合与未见变量值两种设置。
summary.relevance: 直接针对单细胞扰动预测及跨条件泛化。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在两类设置上分别优于现有上下文方法和监督方法，未给出具体指标；依赖存在可共享变量的相关已测条件。

papers.title: Erythrocyte Fate after Subarachnoid Haemorrhage: Compartmental Redistribution, Cellular Processing, and Erythrolysis.
papers.abstract: Subarachnoid haemorrhage (SAH) introduces a large erythrocyte burden into the subarachnoid space (SAS) and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Most mechanistic studies have focused on events after erythrocyte lysis, when cell-free haemoglobin (Hb), haem, iron, and other erythrocyte-derived mediators promote vascular dysfunction, oxidative injury, and inflammation. Before membrane rupture, however, erythrocytes can remain within clot or CSF, undergo transport towards extracranial drainage pathways, or become associated with and internalised by local cells. Evidence from human CSF studies, experimental SAH models, and other haemorrhagic brain injury models indicates that these processes involve heterogeneous erythrocyte populations and need not occur in a fixed sequence. We propose that the erythrocyte burden after SAH is dynamically partitioned among retained cellular, extracranially transported, cell-associated, and extracellular molecular pools. The biological consequences of this redistribution depend on both the rate of transfer between pools and whether lymphatic, phagocytic, haemoglobin-binding, haem-processing, and iron-storage systems become capacity-limited. This framework distinguishes direct evidence from mechanistic inference and generates testable predictions about when erythrocyte removal, cellular uptake, or molecular scavenging will reduce injury rather than redistribute it. Defining erythrocyte fate quantitatively may identify therapeutic opportunities both before and after extracellular erythrolysis.

summary.takeaway: 提出蛛网膜下腔出血后红细胞负荷在滞留细胞、颅外转运、细胞关联和细胞外分子池之间动态分配的框架，强调裂解前过程。
summary.methods: 综述人类脑脊液研究、实验性 SAH 模型及其他出血性脑损伤模型的证据，区分直接证据与机制推断，并提出可检验预测。
summary.relevance: 涉及机制推理与证据整合，与机制推理主题相关。
summary.caveat: 为观点/综述性框架，摘要未提供定量结果；各池间转移速率及容量受限的关键参数仍待验证。

papers.title: Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. Doing it well requires both generating suitable candidates and reliably selecting among them. We present a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to Goal Interpretation in the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI). First, supervised fine-tuning adapts a Large Language Model (LLM) to EAI's output convention. Second, Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE) learns preferences over complete outputs from the model's own generated alternatives. We conducted experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark. Multiple open source LLMs including DeepSeek-V3 chat, DeepSeek-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B were evaluated. The proposed method outperformed the baseline models including LLMs with simple prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph based approaches.

papers.title: When Does Better Confidence Improve a Knowledge-Graph Audit?
papers.abstract: Confidence estimates guide human review in LLM-built knowledge graphs, but better error prediction can yield little improvement in an audit. We study this gap through repairability, selection headroom and label validity. Modelling non-adaptive auditing as budgeted covering, we characterise the minimal decision-relevant error statistics and bound the regret of scalar-preserving first-order planning by a structural mass $Δ^{\mathrm{cl}}$. We simulate ideal repair against benchmark-aligned labels for five extraction configurations and two cross-document graphs on Re-DocRED, followed by frozen confirmation on test and replication on 500 hash-selected training documents. On the held-out cross-document graphs, an error-rate $\times$ fan-out queue leaves 3.98-4.74 percentage points more errors than a joint model with the same actions. By comparison, opening shared actions for that joint planner reduces residual errors by 0.89-1.43 points relative to its own fact-only plans, in point estimates. Equivalence between joint and independent-block models remains inconclusive. Generic LLM verification improves three of four model-budget configurations on each held-out set. LLM adjudication identifies possible benchmark omissions.

summary.takeaway: 研究 LLM 构建知识图谱审计中置信度提升何时真正改善审计效果，提出可修复性、选择余量和标签有效性三个解释因素。
summary.methods: 将非自适应审计建模为预算覆盖问题，刻画最小决策相关错误统计量，并用结构质量 Δ^cl 界定标量保持一阶规划的遗憾；在 Re-DocRED 上模拟理想修复，包含五个抽取配置和两个跨文档图，并进行冻结确认与复制。

summary.caveat: 部分结论基于模拟理想修复与基准对齐标签；联合模型与独立块模型等价性结论不确定，部分效应为点估计。

papers.title: Obstetric pharmacometabolomics.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Pregnancy-related physiologic and metabolic changes influence drug exposure and response. Yet therapeutic decisions often lack individualized biologic guidance. Obstetric pharmacometabolomics uses endogenous metabolic signatures to investigate and potentially predict and monitor drug response in pregnancy. AREAS COVERED: PubMed/MEDLINE and Google Scholar were searched from inception through October 12, 2026, using terms related to metabolomics, pharmacometabolomics, medication exposure, treatment response, maternal-placental-fetal metabolism, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and obstetric medications. Human pregnancy studies, longitudinal investigations, drug-perturbation experiments, and mechanistic preclinical studies were prioritized. This review examines pregnancy-specific metabolic adaptations, analytical approaches, and potential applications involving aspirin, antihypertensives, antidiabetic therapies, antiretrovirals, antimicrobials, corticosteroids, and psychiatric medications. It also considers pharmacometabolic approaches to preeclampsia, gestational diabetes mellitus, preterm birth, fetal growth disorders, obesity, and HIV-associated pregnancy. EXPERT OPINION: Obstetric pharmacometabolomics offers a promising framework for individualized therapeutics, but clinical implementation requires longitudinal studies, standardized biospecimen collection, rigorous exposure assessment, validated biomarkers, and diverse populations. Integration with pharmacogenomics, pharmacomicrobiomics, pharmacoproteomics, and model-informed drug development can improve therapeutic precision, provided that clinical utility is demonstrated.
